items.title: FDA approves belzutifan + lenvatinib for advanced clear-cell RCC after PD-1/PD-L1 — LITESPARK-011
bullets: @OncoAlert / @drenriquegrande / @CancerNetwrk (Brain + Following): FDA on Sep 24, 2026 approved belzutifan plus lenvatinib for adults with advanced RCC with a clear-cell component after prior PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitor therapy.
LITESPARK-011 vs cabozantinib: median PFS 14.6 vs 10.6 months (HR 0.74); OS not significantly different at final analysis — PFS win with the expected OS-debate framing.
Clearest new oncology label overnight vs Sep 24’s lirafugratinib CCA beat — post–checkpoint kidney-cancer option.
items.need_to_know: Top cancer overnight: FDA green-lights belzutifan + lenvatinib for advanced clear-cell RCC after PD-1/PD-L1 progression on LITESPARK-011 PFS data.

items.title: Cell: CD4 T cells + synthetic cytokines turn KRAS responses into durable PDAC remissions
bullets: @Aiims1742 (Brain/OncoAlert): new Cell paper from Stephanie Dougan (Dana-Farber) with Nobel laureate David Baker.
CD4 T cells convert transient responses to KRAS inhibition into durable remissions in pancreatic cancer — synthetic cytokines highlighted.
Highest-signal PDAC biology overnight, distinct from Sep 24’s hepatocytes/serine liver-met Nature and daraxonrasib literacy cluster.
items.need_to_know: Brain-list Cell beat: Dougan/Baker show CD4 T-cell/synthetic-cytokine help can lock in durable KRAS-inhibitor remissions in pancreatic cancer.

items.title: Bikman: RDA protein (0.8 g/kg) is a muscle-loss trap after 50
bullets: @BenBikmanPhD (Keto people + Following): argues the protein RDA wasn’t designed to protect muscle, so older adults eating exactly 0.8 g/kg slowly lose muscle.
Strongest fresh metabolic signal on a still-thin Keto-list overnight (only ~5 in-window list posts).
Pairs with his separate creatine-for-lifters-over-50 note as a practical muscle-preservation cluster.
items.need_to_know: Keto-list metabolic literacy: Bikman says meeting only the protein RDA after 50 is a slow path to sarcopenia.
